latHint: Think sequence - not a lunch line.
pivHint: A cafeteria QUEUE is a waiting line - but in computing, a QUEUE processes data in what?
winText: First in, first out. QUEUE was the pivot - lunch line to data ORDER.
lossText: ORDER - a set sequence in which data is processed. QUEUE was the pivot: a cafeteria line to the first-in-first-out ORDER of a computing queue.
